classification.question_topic: Stopped remembering dreams after repeatedly telling dream characters about prior dreams / breaking the 4th wall; asking if others experienced reduced dream recall after actions in dreams

meta.author_theory: Dreams stopped being remembered after repeatedly telling dream characters about previous dreams; one dream involved screaming at dream people that it was a dream; author wonders if this caused reduced dream access/recall; also mentions increased weed use as possible factor; wonders if they might be having nightmares and waking when aware.

interactions.description: In a sequence of back-to-back dreams in the same night, the dreamer told people in the next dream about the previous dream they had.

entities_involved.description: dream people; did not give much of a reaction

interactions.description: In one 'dreamscape' dream, the dreamer went around screaming at dream people that they were in a dream.

entities_involved.description: dream people the dreamer yelled at

interactions.description: The dreamer reports they usually realize they are dreaming when something bad happens, and then they wake up.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question/meta reflection about dream recall. Contains limited dream phenomenology: back-to-back dreams in the same night; telling dream characters about prior dreams; one dreamscape dream involving screaming that it was a dream; waking after becoming aware when something bad happens. No specific locations or spatial layout described.
